mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, leading to compressed discount rates and higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 2% over the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates on equity cash flows and reducing future returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 3.5%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates expanding demand and labor market strength, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over 20d horizon despite both proxies rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% during a late-cycle expansion signals labor market tightness, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE <4% in late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL exceeding 330 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central banks to maintain tight monetary policy, which compresses equity discount rates and reduces future returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 330.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly supply index (INDPRO) indicate robust demand and production capacity, fostering market optimism and equity price appreciation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite both proxies rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in monthly demand for goods and services (RSAFS) below 700,000 in a post-shock recovery regime signals weakening consumption, leading to reduced corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when RSAFS <700,000 in post-shock regime.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent federal funds rate below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and boosting long-term growth expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 3.5%
